Name: RAM's Clothing Buffs
Author: greenRAM
Description:
RAM's Clothing Buffs is based on aedenthorn's own "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18153/]Clothing Buffs[/url]" mod and uses aedenthorn's awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17746/]Buff Framework[/url].

[b]Includes Buffs for all vanilla:[/b]
-Pants
-Shirts
-Hats
-Shoes

I tried to keep the buffs immersive and relatively balanced, but to my own tastes. For example, the Fishing Hat will buff your fishing +2, while the Pirate Hat will buff your Luck +1 and Attack +5.
